about: The file after each act of four fixed sequences that the model plays, World.step and World.act of model/crdt_model.py of spikes/storage/probes/store-as-a-whole on spikes/storage-survival under the FLAGS of probe/bridge.py, the store as decided, written out as entries by store.py's Encoder as the family's runs write them, and read by read.py with its history rule on; made by vectors.py beside the probe and never from this side. Each sequence starts from the store the model's World starts with, given as start: the authority a0, the profile name pf, the admission of the client c0 under a0 with the profile pf alone, a version of the rule of the root granting read, and a summary entry of height 1, each under the key label K; the two copies of the second and of the third sequence start as the same file. A pairing admits its client with the profiles pf and pg, and a renewal with the profiles of the admission renewed. The first sequence raises the model's maxclients to 4, as growth.py raises it, so that three pairings fit beside c0. The first Create of the sequence asked for, on a database with no store, is not played. On a file with no store the model's Create writes its authority under a new key label, K and a number, while its pairing writes every admission under the label K whatever key the file holds; played from emptied files, every admission after that Create was under a key the file does not hold, passed over by read.py, and the revocation did not apply. The Create after Delete is played: it takes the key the retirement holds. Each step names the command, the model's act, the copy whose file follows, whether the act applied, the store keys of the records present, every record present and every deletion record in the file by identifier, kind, subject and number, the deletion records the step added, each summary entry present with its identifier, its height, the count of its after and its items, read.py's answer as the meanings file gives it, and the file itself. Synchronize is the model's kp_sync merge of a copy into the other, which writes the copy merged into alone: copy 1 into copy 0 in the second sequence, and in the third copy 1 into copy 0 and then copy 0 into copy 1. The third sequence revokes the client c0 in copy 0 and renews its certificate in copy 1, the model's renewcert, which admits the certificate c0.1 under the client key c0 beside the admission of c0, before the copies are synchronized. The records hold v, the model's short names (a0, c1), nonces derived from the model's elements and store keys derived from its labels, so the product holds them by shape and by answer. What the model writes otherwise than STORE.md fixes: no version record at Create and no item format in any summary entry (650, 611); an authority holding id and storeKey alone (614); an admission without der, subject and admitted (615), and a renewal's without from as well (648); a revocation that also holds certificate (615); and a retirement for keeping an authority that does not hold the store key (614). The fourth sequence plays the model's padd and prem, the commands Add and Remove of a profile name, on two copies that start as the same file: pf removed in copy 0 and added again there, naming that removal; pf removed in copy 1; pg added in each copy; a Synchronize of copy 1 into copy 0 and then of copy 0 into copy 1; pf added again in copy 0, naming both removals; and the two Synchronize again in the same order. Once the copies meet, pf is off the list in both and pg on it by two additions, and once pf is added again and synchronized, it is on the list in both, and both copies hold the same file. The model's pairing writes no addition for a name it approves, which STORE.md 627 has a pairing write: no pairing here puts pg on the list.
